main_text.p: Sunt & quædam quæ me fuge-runt, vt pag.167.libro 111. ῥομβειδῆ, pro ῥομβοει. & 197. κατιζωσμένης, pro κατεζωσμένης. 220. ἐϑίσο, pro ἐϑίσο: & tu Lector alia vide.

page.notes: Doubtful readings marked [?]: several Greek forms in the right column (pag. ς, 24, 75, 129, 141, 185, Ibid. ἀροτετίμητο, 221) are blurred in the scan and should be checked against the original. The Greek in the closing paragraph (ῥομβειδῆ, κατιζωσμένης, ἐϑίσο) was read as printed but is not fully certain. The faint handwritten marking at the top left is not printed and is left out.
